annotations.title: Romania company KYB risk check (insolvency, ANAF status, Altman Z)

description: $0.02 per call (x402, USDC on Base, no account). Use when onboarding a supplier/customer, extending credit or before paying an invoice. Get the CUI with romania_company_search. KYB, supplier verification and due diligence for a Romanian company by CUI: risk score 0-100, level low/medium/high and reasons: ONRC insolvency (insolvență), bankruptcy (faliment), dissolution, sequestration, criminal case; ANAF/ONRC inactive or deregistered (radiată); balance sheet red flags (missing bilanț, losses, negative equity, falling turnover) and Altman Z'.

cui.description: CUI / CIF (Romanian company tax ID, cod fiscal): digits with optional RO prefix, e.g. 2816464 or RO2816464. Get it with romania_company_search.
